ModMetaData.name: Missing Art Fixes
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Loose-texture overrides for third-party art that is missing or empty.
Every file here replaces one texture in another mod that ships broken. Nothing is patched, no defs are touched, and no mod is altered: RimWorld resolves a texture as loose file in any active mod, then base game resources, then AssetBundles. A loose PNG at the same path wins over a bundled asset regardless of load order, so each fix is a single file dropped at the path the def already asks for.
Contents:
OuterRim/Hairs/Cerean/CereanMane_south Outer Rim - Galactic Diversity ships this file with alpha max 0 - it is completely empty, 0 of 262,144 pixels. A Cerean with the mane hairstyle renders BALD from the front, the most common facing. Drawn to match the donor's own conventions: 512x512, 11 px black keyline, vertical greyscale gradient, registered to the north view's x-range and top edge because every healthy Cerean pair shares those.
OuterRim/Droid/MSE_north Outer Rim - Droid Depot ships MSE_south and MSE_east only, while OuterRim_MSEDroid declares Graphic_Multi. A north-facing droid silently falls back and shows its FRONT while walking away. The silhouette and keyline are taken pixel-for-pixel from MSE_south so registration is exact; only the interior is re-authored, replacing the front bevel with a plain rear panel.
Neither defect can produce a log line. "Failed to find any textures at" fires only when EVERY direction is missing, and a present-but-empty PNG is a successful load by every measure the engine has. Both were found by reading pixels, not logs.
